group.name: Re:erth
group.description: An abbreviation of “Re-encountering Earth”, Re:erth is a Singapore-based skincare label produced in Japan. The brand adopts a minimalistic approach to beauty with cruelty-free multi-purpose products created from nature-derived and sustainably farmed ingredients. The brand also has a recycling program in partnership with Environmental Solutions Asia, allowing customers to return empty Re:erth bottles as-is (without washing or dismantling) and collect redeemable reward points in a circular system.
